note: Sierra County NM has no county zoning ordinance (2017 comprehensive plan says only subdivision and flood plain ordinances). The largest city, Truth or Consequences, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (torcnm.gov/media/ty4nx4um/zoning-map.pdf), with no ArcGIS or other queryable service. Elephant Butte publishes no zoning GIS. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Sierra County and Truth or Consequences found no zoning district service; only third-party sites (Zoneomics, Regrid) carry zoning, and they are not official.
